scenes.method: Preloaded original SPZ/AP16, hash and pair validation outside timing. Both variants copy the same compressed input outside timing; native variant includes Blob creation, native gzip inflation, bounds/header validation and stored-envelope construction in adapterMs. Spark still consumes gzip in both paths. AP16 is applied using the verified ORIGINAL source digest after a lossless temporary envelope transform; no persisted sidecar rebind. Full raw digest checked outside timing; every decoded ExtSplats/SH buffer and render controls checked after timing. One warmup per variant and four serial ABBA groups in the same viewer/worker pool, fresh models. total ends at settle/draw submission, not presentation or GPU timing. HTTP, cold runtime, cancellation/fallback, peak memory and sustained frame rate not measured.
